title: TTS-Q: Perception-Guided Post-Training Quantization of Text-to-Speech Diffusion Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2610.12474v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) can clone a voice from seconds of audio. Yet the quality comes from billion-parameter diffusion transformers whose size and multi-step sampling put them out of reach of the on-device, assistive, and real-time applications that need them most. Post-training quantization (PTQ) shrinks such models without retraining, but it has been built for language and vision, not speech. At 4 bits, a strong quantizer leaves intelligibility close to full precision but consistently erodes speaker timbre, so error rates stay low while the voice drifts from the target speaker. We ask why quantization hurts speech, where the damage lives, and whether it can be repaired without retraining. To find out, we run the first 4-bit weight-and-activation (W4A4) PTQ study of a TTS diffusion transformer at 1B and 3.5B. translated_title: TTS-Q：面向文本到语音扩散变换器的感知引导训练后量化
translated_abstract: 零样本文本到语音（TTS）技术只需几秒钟的音频即可克隆一个声音。然而其高质量的生成依赖于数十亿参数的扩散变换器，其庞大的模型规模和多步采样过程使得最需要该技术的端侧设备、辅助技术和实时应用难以使用。训练后量化（PTQ）无需重新训练即可压缩此类模型，但现有方法是为语言和视觉领域设计的，而非语音领域。在4比特精度下，强量化器虽然能让语音可懂度接近全精度水平，但会持续损害说话人音色，导致错误率保持较低的同时，声音却偏离了目标说话人。我们探究了为什么量化会损害语音、损伤存在于何处，以及能否在不重新训练的情况下进行修复。为此，我们对1B和3.5B规模的TTS扩散变换器开展了首个4比特权重与激活（W4A4）训练后量化研究。研究发现，音色损失同时来自权重量化和激活量化，但只有激活部分具有时间维度的特性……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文首次对十亿参数规模的TTS扩散变换器开展4比特权重与激活（W4A4）训练后量化研究，揭示了量化主要损害说话人音色而非可懂度这一现象及其来源，并提出感知引导的量化修复方法。
en_tdlr: The first W4A4 post-training quantization study of billion-parameter TTS diffusion transformers, revealing why 4-bit quantization erodes speaker timbre while preserving intelligibility, and proposing a perception-guided approach to repair it without retraining.
